lyrics.ja: 夕映えに揺蕩う少し伸びた前髪とかげぼうし巡る日々
lyrics.romaji: Yūbae ni tayutau sukoshi nobita maegami to kagebōshi meguru hibi
lyrics.en: Swaying in the sunset light, slightly overgrown bangs and shadows in the passing days
lyrics.zh: 晚霞中搖曳稍微變長的前髮與影子匆匆流轉的日子

lyrics.ja: 楽しかった分だけ今日が終わってしまうことが
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshikatta bun dake kyō ga owatte shimau koto ga
lyrics.en: Just as much as it was fun, the fact that today is coming to an end
lyrics.zh: 惟獨愉快的時光在今天就會迎來結束

lyrics.ja: どうしても寂しくなるけど
lyrics.romaji: Doushitemo sabishiku naru kedo
lyrics.en: Makes me feel lonely no matter what, but
lyrics.zh: 雖然無論如何都會感到寂寞

lyrics.ja: 忘れないで同じそらを見上げていること
lyrics.romaji: Wasurenaide onaji sora wo miagete iru koto
lyrics.en: Please don't forget that we are looking up at the exact same sky
lyrics.zh: 但請別忘記我們正仰望着同一片的天空

lyrics.ja: どんな君だって愛しく思うから
lyrics.romaji: Donna kimi datte itoshiku omou kara
lyrics.en: Because no matter who you are, I cherish you so dearly
lyrics.zh: 不論是怎樣的你我亦會深深愛着

lyrics.ja: 大丈夫、大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Daijoubu, daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: I will sing 'It's alright, it's going to be alright'
lyrics.zh: 為你唱著「沒關係，沒關係的」

lyrics.ja: 変わりゆく中で変わらない気持ちで
lyrics.romaji: Kawariyuku naka de kawaranai kimochi de
lyrics.en: Amidst all changes, with feelings that never change
lyrics.zh: 在改變的過程中懷著始終不渝的心情

lyrics.ja: ずっと大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Zutto daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: I will keep singing 'Everything is going to be fine'
lyrics.zh: 一直對你唱著「不要緊的」

lyrics.ja: 時間も距離も越えて心は側にあるから
lyrics.romaji: Jikan mo kyori mo koete kokoro wa soba ni aru kara
lyrics.en: Transcending time and distance, my heart will always be by your side
lyrics.zh: 超越過時間與距離我心時刻與你相隨

lyrics.ja: 通り雨に濡れて凍えた爪先じゃ上手く歩けずに惑う日々
lyrics.romaji: Tooriame ni nurete kogoeta tsumasaki ja umaku arukezu ni madou hibi
lyrics.en: Drenched by a passing shower, wandering days unable to walk well with frozen toes
lyrics.zh: 被驟雨淋濕因冰冷的腳尖而無法順利邁步迷惘躊躇的日子

lyrics.ja: 悲しかった分だけ明日が少しでも輝くように
lyrics.romaji: Kanashikatta bun dake ashita ga sukoshi demo kagayaku you ni
lyrics.en: Hoping tomorrow shines a little brighter for all the sadness experienced
lyrics.zh: 惟獨悲傷的時光亦深盼能讓明天更為璀璨

lyrics.ja: いつでも願っているから
lyrics.romaji: Itsudemo nagatte iru kara
lyrics.en: Because I am always wishing for it
lyrics.zh: 我會一直如此祈求

lyrics.ja: 一緒に掛け替えないときを重ねてゆこうよどこまでも
lyrics.romaji: Issho ni kakegae no nai toki wo kasanete yukou yo doko mademo
lyrics.en: Let's weave irreplaceable moments together wherever we go
lyrics.zh: 讓我們共度無可替代的時間一起前進吧不論海角或天涯

notes.word: 掛け替えない（かけがえのない）

lyrics.ja: 頑張れない日も涙が出ない夜も
lyrics.romaji: Ganbarenai hi mo namida ga denai yoru mo
lyrics.en: Even on days you can't push through, and nights when tears won't fall
lyrics.zh: 意志消沉的每日欲哭無淚的每夜

lyrics.ja: 大丈夫、大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Daijoubu, daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: I will sing 'It's alright, it's going to be alright'
lyrics.zh: 我亦會為你唱著「沒關係，沒關係的」

lyrics.ja: 新しい一歩を君が踏み出す朝も
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii ippo wo kimi ga fumidasu asa mo
lyrics.en: Even on mornings when you take a brand new step forward
lyrics.zh: 哪怕是你邁出新的一步的清晨

lyrics.ja: ちゃんと大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Chanto daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: I will properly sing 'It's definitely going to be fine'
lyrics.zh: 亦會好好對你唱著「不要緊的」

lyrics.ja: そうちっぽけな僕ら心揺れながらも
lyrics.romaji: Sou chippoke na bokura kokoro yurenagara mo
lyrics.en: Yes, even though our small selves waver inside
lyrics.zh: 對啊即使是微不足道的我們內心起伏不定

lyrics.ja: 大切を重ねて未来を描く
lyrics.romaji: Taisetsu wo kasanete mirai wo egaku
lyrics.en: We gather precious memories and paint our future
lyrics.zh: 亦要積累重要的事物描繪出未來

lyrics.ja: どんな僕だって愛してくれたこと
lyrics.romaji: Donna boku datte aishite kureta koto
lyrics.en: That you loved me no matter who or how I was
lyrics.zh: 不論是怎樣的我你亦願意深深愛著

lyrics.ja: いつだっていつだって忘れないから
lyrics.romaji: Itsudatte itsudatte wasurenai kara
lyrics.en: I will never, ever forget it
lyrics.zh: 永永遠遠永永遠遠我都絕不忘懷

lyrics.ja: 変わりゆく中で変わらない気持ちで
lyrics.romaji: Kawariyuku naka de kawaranai kimochi de
lyrics.en: Amidst all changes, with feelings that never change
lyrics.zh: 在改變的過程中懷著始終不渝的心情

lyrics.ja: 僕の精一杯で返すから
lyrics.romaji: Boku no seippai de kaesu kara
lyrics.en: I will return it to you with everything I've got
lyrics.zh: 我會竭盡全力去回報你

lyrics.ja: どんな君だって愛しく思うから
lyrics.romaji: Donna kimi datte itoshiku omou kara
lyrics.en: Because no matter who you are, I cherish you so dearly
lyrics.zh: 不論是怎樣的你我亦會深深愛著

lyrics.ja: 大丈夫、大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Daijoubu, daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: I will sing 'It's alright, it's going to be alright'
lyrics.zh: 為你唱著「沒關係，沒關係的」

lyrics.ja: 辿り着いた今日の日に君という光に逢えた
lyrics.romaji: Tadoritsuita kyou no hi ni kimi to iu hikari ni aeta
lyrics.en: On this day we finally reached, I met the light that is you
lyrics.zh: 最終所抵達的今天我遇見了名為你的光

lyrics.ja: だから、大丈夫だって歌うから
lyrics.romaji: Dakara, daijoubu datte utau kara
lyrics.en: So, I will sing 'Everything is going to be okay'
lyrics.zh: 所以，我會向你唱著「不要緊的」

lyrics.ja: 時間も距離も越えて心は側にあるから
lyrics.romaji: Jikan mo kyori mo koete kokoro wa soba ni aru kara
lyrics.en: Transcending time and distance, my heart will always be by your side
lyrics.zh: 超越過時間與距離我心時刻與你相隨
